data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-m-h', meaning 'to be gentle, soft, or tender'. In Islamic tradition, Lameeah is a beautiful name for a delicate and gentle girl. The name Lameeah carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lameeah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lameeah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lameeah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
